text: AI assistants can connect to and query your Supabase projects on your behalf
quote: Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.

text: Two-command CLI workflow (`init`, `start`) sets up and launches a local Supabase project
quote:
With two commands, you can set up and start a new local project:
1. `supabase init` to create a new local project
2. `supabase start` to launch the Supabase services

text: Self-hosting supported for full data control, compliance, or isolated environments
quote: Self-hosting is a good fit if you need full control over your data, have compliance requirements that prevent you from using managed services, or want to run Supabase in an isolated environment.

text: Postgres Row Level Security provides granular, in-database authorization rules
quote: Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) gives you granular authorization rules that run inside the database.

text: Broadcast and Presence let clients send low-latency messages and track/synchronize online user state
quote: Broadcast: Send low-latency messages between clients... Presence: Track and synchronize user state across clients... Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time.

text: Postgres Changes lets clients listen to database changes in real time
quote: Broadcast: Send low-latency messages between clients... Presence: Track and synchronize user state across clients... Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time.

text: Users can sign in via password, magic link, OTP, social login, or SSO
quote: Your users can use many popular Auth methods, including password, magic link, one-time password (OTP), social login, and single sign-on (SSO).

text: Storage service manages files of any size with fine-grained access controls and optimized delivery
quote: Supabase Storage is a robust, scalable solution for managing files of any size with fine-grained access controls and optimized delivery.

text: Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions distributed globally close to users
quote: Edge Functions are server-side TypeScript functions, distributed globally at the edge—close to your users.

text: Open-source toolkit for building AI applications using Postgres and pgvector
quote: Supabase provides an open source toolkit for developing AI applications using Postgres and pgvector.

text: Branching lets you create isolated environments to test schema/config changes before production
quote: You can use these branching environments to create and test changes like new configurations, database schemas, or features without affecting your production setup.

text: Generate TypeScript types (`database.types.ts`) for your project schema
quote: Generate types for your project to produce the `database.types.ts` file

text: Compute can scale up to 64 cores and 256 GB RAM
quote:
Scale compute up to  
64 cores and 256 GB RAM

text: Instant ready-to-use REST APIs generated for your project
quote: Instant ready-to-use REST APIs.

text: APIs are auto-generated via database introspection into type-safe definitions
quote: Supabase APIs are generated from your database, which means that we can use database introspection to generate type-safe API definitions.

text: Auto-generated GraphQL API available alongside REST
quote:
Auto-generated APIs.
  - [x] REST. [Docs]
  - [x] GraphQL. [Docs]
  - [x] Realtime subscriptions.

text: CLI can run the entire Supabase stack locally, including in CI environments
quote: The Supabase CLI enables you to run the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.

text: Storage supports fine-grained access control via row-level security and custom policies
quote: Fine-grained Access Control - Manage file permissions with row-level security and custom policies

text: Dashboard lets you manage your app without leaving it
quote:
Stay productive and manage your app  
without leaving the dashboard

text: Project stack lets you add Auth, Data APIs, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, and Vector embeddings on top of Postgres
quote: Start your project with a Postgres database. Add Authentication, Data APIs, Edge Functions, Realtime Data, Storage, and Vector embeddings.
